# St. George Foam

> Washington County's full-service spray foam insulation company, serving St. George, Utah and
> the surrounding region — open-cell and closed-cell spray foam for attics/roof decks, exterior
> walls, crawl spaces, garages/shops, and commercial/metal buildings, plus spray foam removal and
> correction for improperly installed prior jobs. Residential and commercial. Not a general
> insulation shop (never fiberglass batts or blown-in) — spray foam only, full scope. Not an
> insurance provider.

Phone: 844-967-5247
Email: josh@contractorschoiceagency.com
Base city: St. George, UT (Washington County, hot desert climate, IECC Zone 3B). Service area:
St. George, Washington City, Hurricane, Santa Clara, Ivins, plus the broader LaVerkin/Toquerville
region.
